title: Responsiveness Bonus on Same-Day Earnings for Payout Methods On-Request Payouts
content:
**What does the responsiveness bonus do?** It raises the on-request share of fresh earnings, the part of the earnings released to a Payout Methods method on the request date that an on-request payout includes. The on-request responsiveness bonus raises that share by 10 percentage points when the most recent Superhost assessment records a response rate of at least 99.00 percent, by 4 points when it records at least 95.00 percent but less than 99.00 percent, and by none otherwise.

**Where is the response rate found?** On the host's most recent Superhost assessment in the Host Accounts records: the message response rate over the assessment's lookback, as the messaging system recorded it.

**How do the bands compare?**

| Response rate on the most recent Superhost assessment | Raise to the on-request share of fresh earnings |
|---|---|
| 99.00 percent or more | 10 percentage points |
| 95.00 percent to below 99.00 percent | 4 percentage points |
| Below 95.00 percent, or no assessment on record | None |

**Is the bonus a percentage of the share or points added to it?** Points added to it: an imagined share of 70 percent raised by 4 percentage points becomes 74 percent.

**Where are the lines exactly?** With hypothetical assessments:

| Response rate | Raise |
|---|---|
| 99.00 | 10 points |
| 98.99 | 4 points |
| 95.00 | 4 points |
| 94.99 | None |

**Does the bonus depend on the average rating?** No. It reads only the response rate recorded on the most recent Superhost assessment.

**Hypothetical example.** An imagined host's most recent assessment records a response rate of 96.50 percent. The on-request share of fresh earnings is raised by 4 percentage points; on an imagined share of 70 percent, the payout includes 74 percent of the earnings released to the method on the request date.
